question: What inauspicious consequences follow from misplaced marks on the liṅga?
premises: A mark placed on the head indicates disease.
A mark placed on the forehead indicates death.
inference: Misplaced marks on the liṅga portend disease if on the head and death if on the forehead.
plain_english: If the mark falls on the head, there will be disease; if on the forehead, there will be death.
